subject.title: [Feishu] Interactive Card message content parsing missing

question: What agent-visible payload contract should Feishu interactive cards use across direct inbound cards, card-action form/select callbacks, and merge_forward card sub-messages?
rationale: Source proves the direct inbound gap, but exposing full card/form/select data while preserving existing command-style button behavior is a channel product/API choice rather than a purely mechanical cleanup.

options.title: Coordinate scoped plugin fixes
options.body: Keep this issue as the broad tracker, land direct inbound parser reuse in the Feishu plugin, and let the callback-field and merge_forward issues own their narrower payload details.

options.title: Split to direct inbound only
options.body: Narrow this issue to direct message_type=interactive parsing and leave action callbacks and merge_forward behavior entirely to their existing linked items.

options.title: Defer full payload exposure
options.body: Pause broad card parsing until maintainers decide agents should not receive full Feishu card/form payloads beyond current text extraction.

recommendation.title: Coordinate scoped plugin fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the broad tracker, land direct inbound parser reuse in the Feishu plugin, and let the callback-field and merge_forward issues own their narrower payload details.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names m1heng as the Feishu/Lark community-maintained plugin contact, making them the best available owner for the channel behavior contract.
